description: MLflow connector. Surfaces MLflow registered models — name, description, latest version/stage/status/run, created + updated timestamps, and tags — into the local index as `mlflow:ml_model` items via the Model Registry API (`GET /api/2.0/mlflow/registered-models/search`, token-paginated on `next_page_token`). API-token auth (sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`). MLflow has no universal SaaS host: the tracking-server URL is supplied via the `mlflow.host` vault key and added to the sandbox network list at spawn time by `phase3AddMlflowMcp`, so the static manifest network list is intentionally empty. v1 indexes registered models only — experiments, runs, metrics, params, and artifacts are a deferred follow-up. Two HITL-gated write tools transition a model version's stage (`POST /api/2.0/mlflow/model-versions/transition-stage`): `mlflow_model_promote` (promote to Production, HITL `mlflow.model.promote`; `archiveExisting` defaults true) and `mlflow_model_transition_stage` (transition to any stage, HITL `mlflow.model.transition_stage`; `archiveExisting` defaults false). Stage changes are reversible.
